page: Amazon Web Services d3en.2xlarge is a storage-optimized instance designed for dense local storage capacity. Running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon Platinum 8259CL processor clocked at 3.1 GHz. The architecture uses an x86_64 instruction set with 35 MB of L3 cache, supporting AVX-512 extensions and AES hardware acceleration. The instance is paired with 32.0 GB of DDR4 memory clocked at 3 GHz, delivering 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It does not include hardware GPU acceleration.

The defining characteristic of the d3en.2xlarge is its bundled local storage capacity, which consists of 55,920 GB (approximately 54.6 TB) of local HDD storage. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, providing reliable throughput for massive data ingestion and sequential transfers. The hardware profile exhibits a clear tradeoff: it offers exceptional storage density per compute thread at the expense of pure compute power. Benchmark data indicates modest single-thread and multi-core processor performance, with stress-ng single-core results in the bottom 25% and Geekbench multi-core scores ranking similarly low. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate average throughput, sustaining 51.86 GB/s on large uncached block reads and 39.4 GB/s on uncached writes.

Because the compute profile is conservative, the instance trades away computational throughput to deliver cost-effective local capacity for bulk data retention. Application throughput reflects this balance, showing standard midrange metrics in Redis SET operations (6.7 million operations per second) and static web serving throughput (7.17 GB/s), but poor efficiency on compute-heavy tasks such as medium-sized LLM inference. This profile makes the d3en.2xlarge best suited for sequential read/write storage workloads, distributed file systems, data lakes, log aggregation clusters, and massive backup or archival processing.
description: Amazon Web Services d3en.2xlarge is a storage-optimized instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs from 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8259CL processor at 3.1 GHz, 32.0 GB of DDR4 memory, and no GPUs. It distinguishes itself through an exceptionally large bundled local storage pool of 55,920 GB of local HDD storage, supported by a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the instance exhibits modest compute performance, placing in the lower percentiles in single-core and multi-core processor benchmarks, but delivers consistent midrange throughput for memory bandwidth, Redis operations, and static content delivery. The architectural focus centers on massive disk density rather than intense processing power. This makes the d3en.2xlarge well aligned for cost-effective mass storage workloads, distributed big data architectures, sequential log aggregation, and long-term analytical file storage.
